entries.notes: Not exact (decision 092). Recording R-086a (ao-mixed-opacity and its OpenEXR 32f twin, decision 087) shows AO_Mixed on the 8-bit lattice before encoding, step A = step B, and r1 != r2 by one 8-bit step at 9 to 41 values per set, deterministically. Best model: alpha = the layer opacity's L16 code / 65535 and C = the fill's stored L16 code / 65535 (float32); c = fma(C - 1, alpha, 1), the AO channel before its L16 write (1 without a layer; WriteUnorm16(c) is the channel's export, 0 differing on r1); a = the AO mesh map code / 255; v = a c (float32); AO_Mixed = WriteUnorm(v, 8) (12 fractional bits, nearest, ties down). It misses r1 at 31 values over the three goldens (ao-mixed-opacity s0-s7 0/9/2/0/0/9/2/0, its twin the same, ao-mixed s0-s3 0/9/0/0), each within 3 ulps of v from a 2^-12 boundary; r2 misses more and is not explained. On the row where C = 0, c = 1 - alpha is exact in any order of operations, yet v must rise by 2 to 3 ulps, so no correctly rounded float32 evaluation of the tested inputs reproduces r1. Rejected: more than 40 orders of operations with and without fma, multiply blends over the mesh map, fixed-point (2^12 to 2^29) and half-float intermediates, a 16-bit intermediate, other conversions of a, C and alpha, and the recording GPU's measured exp2, log2 and reciprocal. Unknown: Painter's operand conversions or arithmetic on this path. Recording R-092 isolates them: a constant AO mesh map with a varying channel, a constant channel with a varying mesh map, values at the missed coordinates, and the same exports after reopen. Calibrated is not parity: the plan refuses AO_Mixed.

entries.notes: Operator: enc(L (1 - m)), RGB. Fitted exactly (decision 092): r1 = r2 on every texel of s0-s7 at PNG 16 and OpenEXR 32f, 0 differing values in each of the 16 comparisons. Inputs: L the BaseColor channel's linear sRGB8 operand, r and m the SpecularRoughness and BaseMetalness values, float32; enc is Painter 12.1.5's sRGB encode x <= 0.0031308 ? 12.92 x : fma(1.055, exp2(0.41666 log2 x), -0.055) with the recording GPU's exp2 and log2; toL(v) = fma(0.114, v, fma(0.299, v, 0.587 v)). Where a channel has no layer the map reads L = 1.3, r = 0.5980393 (0x3F19191A) and m = 0, not the channel's base value. Still a release gap: the plan needs each channel's per-texel coverage (the evaluator gives none), and the uncovered constants were seen on one template only (recording R-092).
